M-CANVAS-VIEW-WIDGET.Purpose: Viewport container with independent two-dimensional Pan and uniform Zoom of its child coordinate space, preserving Flexbox layout.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: CanvasView and reactive Pan, Zoom, MinZoom, MaxZoom Props.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Mouse pan and wheel zoom through FlexEvent and TransformService-local pointer coordinates.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Common child clip and exact hit testing — owned by M-CLIP-SERVICE and M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE.

Requirements.REQ-001: GetChildrenTransform composes child-only translation and uniform scale; self drawing and Flexbox layout remain unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-002: Zoom is finite, strictly positive and clamped to effective MinZoom/MaxZoom without rewriting the external source Behavior.
Requirements.REQ-003: Wheel zoom keeps the content point under the pointer fixed when calculating the new Pan.
Requirements.REQ-004: Pan begins on middle mouse or on empty-canvas left mouse, not on descendant-owned gestures; nested ScrollView owns its scroll wheel.
Requirements.REQ-005: CanvasView defaults to hidden overflow; drag ownership ends on release, leave and unmount.

Inputs.IN-001: Pan, Zoom, MinZoom, MaxZoom Behaviors and FlexEvent pointer events.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Own pan and zoom Props update in response to recognized gestures.
